# 💳 EAS Update Insights

💳 EAS is a paid Expo Application Services product — the data behind these commands counts against your plan's EAS Update usage. Curated by Skill Harbor — an official Expo skill that queries the health of published EAS Updates straight from the CLI: per-platform launches, failed launches, crash rates, unique users, payload size and daily breakdowns (`eas update:insights`), plus the embedded-vs-OTA user split per channel and the most popular updates per runtime version (`eas channel:insights`), in human or JSON form for CI gating and post-publish rollout monitoring. By @expo, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: aggregate metrics only — no per-user crash detail or device-level reporting; metrics lag the real-world state (crashes are self-reported on the next update check) and can double-count users running the same publish on both platforms. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
